name: koin-flow-scope
description: Team standard for passing data between screens in a Kotlin Multiplatform app with shared ViewModels and Koin: one Koin scope per multi-screen flow holding a FlowData object, opened and closed by one owner class that ViewModels receive through their constructor. Built on the official Koin skills (Koin 4.x; Compiler Plugin DSL, classic DSL or Annotations): fresh data on start, read in loadInitData, write before navigating, close on finish and on cancel, process death, iOS bridge, an owner test per flow, and migration checklists.
